acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast linear scoring and circular lesions visible on the ventral surface of the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetrical serration depth on the right lobe trailing edge relative to the visible left lobe margin.
